import ctypes
import os

# Load the dynamic libraries
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_rng type
class gsl_rng(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

# Define the function prototypes
# gsl_rng_uniform
gsl.gsl_rng_uniform.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rng)]
gsl.gsl_rng_uniform.restype = ctypes.c_double

# gsl_ran_bernoulli
gsl.gsl_ran_bernoulli.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rng), ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_ran_bernoulli.restype = ctypes.c_uint

# gsl_rng_alloc
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rng)

# gsl_rng_free
gsl.gsl_rng_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rng)]
gsl.gsl_rng_free.restype = None

# gsl_rng_default
gsl.gsl_rng_default = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_rng_default")


def bernoulli_trial(rng, p):
    """Simulate a Bernoulli trial using the GSL library."""
    if not (0.0 <= p <= 1.0):
        raise ValueError("Probability p must be between 0 and 1.")
    return gsl.gsl_ran_bernoulli(rng, p)


def assert_test():
    # Initialize the random number generator
    rng = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc(gsl.gsl_rng_default)
    try:
        # Test with p = 0.0, should always return 0
        assert bernoulli_trial(rng, 0.0) == 0
        # Test with p = 1.0, should always return 1
        assert bernoulli_trial(rng, 1.0) == 1
        # Test with p = 0.5, should return 0 or 1
        result = bernoulli_trial(rng, 0.5)
        assert result in (0, 1)
        # Test with invalid p < 0, should raise an error
        try:
            bernoulli_trial(rng, -0.1)
            assert False, "Expected ValueError for p < 0"
        except ValueError:
            pass
        # Test with invalid p > 1, should raise an error
        try:
            bernoulli_trial(rng, 1.1)
            assert False, "Expected ValueError for p > 1"
        except ValueError:
            pass
    finally:
        # Free the random number generator
        gsl.gsl_rng_free(rng)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
